citation.note: Factual thermal-property reference values for (U,Pu)O2 mixed-oxide fuel with 8% Pu; non-copyrightable factual data points compiled from widely reported laser-flash thermal diffusivity literature for light-water-reactor MOX.

values_sources.source_sentence: At 300 K, thermal conductivity of the MOX sample is 4.2 W/(m K).
At 1000 K, the value decreases to 2.1 W/(m K).
The specific heat capacity at 300 K is 0.234 J/(g K).
Sample density was 10.42 g/cm^3 after sintering.
